## About This Project

This project explores county-level demographic shifts across Florida between the 2000 and 2020 Decennial Censuses, focusing on changes in Hispanic, non-Hispanic White, Black, and Asian population shares.

## Data Source

Data is sourced from the **U.S. Census Bureau** decennial censuses (2000, 2010, and 2020) retrieved using the [`tidycensus`](https://walker-data.com/tidycensus/) package in R:

- **2000 & 2010:** Summary File 1 (SF1)
- **2020:** Public Law 94-171 Redistricting Data Summary File

## Tools & Packages

- **R & RStudio**
- **Quarto** for reproducible web publishing
- **Leaflet & sf** for spatial data manipulation and interactive mapping
- **Tidyverse** for data reshaping and analysis

This project was created by [JMercado30](https://github.com/JMercado30) as part of data science coursework.
